gemini.performance_metric: divested EP Energy E&P business for $7.2 billion simultaneously with close

No post-deal disruptions at the product-process (p4_pathway=0) or process-organization (p5_pathway=0) interfaces were documented.

grok.performance_metric: EP Energy divested at close for $7.2bn; natural-gas assets integrated

Section 4 explicitly codes P4 and P5 as none documented for retained assets; T1 and T2 mismatches resolved by divestiture rather than manifested.
